title: Chapter 6587: Enough Disturbance

Chapter 6587: Enough Disturbance

Chapter 6587: Enough Disturbance

“If you have no business here, please leave, Junior Brother Guo.” Teng Sujian ignored him and said.

Her cold demeanor infuriated him but he could only channel his rage toward Li Qiye.

“Sir, may I ask for your affiliation and cultivation?” He cupped his fist and exerted his power forward.

Politeness was unnecessary against an ordinary cultivator. He could defeat a hundred Li Qiyes in the blink of an eye. Embarrassing the guy was the only way to quell his jealousy.

Sujian knew his intent and was still far stronger despite the dao damage, casually swinging her hand and sending the attacker flying.

“Ugh.” He fell to the ground, vomiting blood.

She held back or it could have made him bedridden for a year, if not outright kill him.

“Senior Sister!” He was furious, not expecting a palm strike against his chest.

However, she ignored him and continued peeling the shell. This only further enraged him.

Moreover, Li Qiye didn’t bother to look at him during the ordeal. His face turned red as he trembled.

“Oh, our First Sister?” A girl arrived this time with a group of exceptional female cultivators. Her mighty aura chased everyone in the valley away.

She was beautiful and even sexy. However, her aura was aggressive.

“Senior Sister Baili!” Junior Brother Guo was ecstatic to see her.

She was also a genius from the Teng, once competing as a rival during their younger days. Alas, Sujian became far stronger and left her in the dust.

She had never accepted defeat and wanted to crush her prideful demeanor. Now that Sujian had failed the ascension, it was her chance.

Sujian only glanced at Baili once before resuming her task. Baili became annoyed since Sujian still appeared arrogant like before. Times have changed and Sujian was no longer the clan’s golden child.

“This is your man, Senior Sister? You have quite a peculiar taste, foregoing geniuses for something so ordinary. Must be tired of delicacies and going for plain meals instead.” Baili taunted.

Sujian’s eyes became piercing upon hearing this.

“Oh, maybe I’m wrong. Since your dao shattered, you must be hating yourself, so you picked a random man to marry...” Baili went on while looking at Li Qiye.

“A filthy mouth deserves a slap.” Li Qiye yawned and said.

Baili had reservations about Sujian. Even if her power had regressed, few members of the young generation could match her. However, this man was a different story.

“Filthy fool, do you think you’re special now that you’ve hooked up with an impressive cultivator? I will cut off your tongue.” Her eyes turned cold.

The Teng was a major clan in World City so killing some random man was no problem. A light flashed and she held a sharp dagger, wanting to cut Li Qiye’s whole mouth off, not just his tongue.

Punishing Li Qiye was one thing; this also served to embarrass Sujian.

“Clank!” Sujian stopped the dagger with her fingers.

“Senior Sister, men like him are everywhere, so replaceable.” Baili smiled alluringly.

Sujian’s expression darkened.

“Kill her, enough disturbance.” Li Qiye ordered.

Sujian paused because despite the conflict between them, she didn’t wish to kill a cousin.

“Brat, you court...” She said murderously but couldn’t finish: “Ugh...”

Her eyes widened in disbelief because Li Qiye pushed the dagger that Sujian had stopped into her throat. She couldn’t scream so only muffled noises came out.

“!!!” The others were shocked to see this.

If Sujian was considered a princess from the direct line, then Baili was a princess from a branch.

Sujian herself didn’t think Baili deserved death, just a lesson would have sufficed. Alas, she couldn’t do anything to stop it.

As for the killer, he didn’t bother to take a look as if he had just swatted a fly.
